svg.text: Shipped frames from sprites.json. Ground rings draw under the build; the shimmer dome and glints draw over it. Shadows and radii are code.
shield-gen/* and beacon/*: flight · landed · active · damaged (< 50% HP) · destroyed. mine/*: armed · trigger; the blast is mine-blast-ring (ground) + mine-blast (effects).
Brute target flash (theirs) on a build
brute-target (ground, under the build) + brute-target-arrow (effects; anchor = tip, set just above the build top).
effects/shield-shimmer-1..3 (cycle) over shield-base (ground). The dome’s foot follows the front of the base ring.
